summary: Official inference runtime for 1-bit (ternary) LLMs trained under the BitNet b1.58 scheme. Lossless CPU inference: 2.37x-6.17x speedup and 71.9-82.2% energy reduction on x86. Can run 100B-parameter models at 5-7 tok/s on consumer CPUs. MIT license. Flagship model: BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T (2.4B params, trained on 4T tokens). GPU support added May 2025.
key_insight: Ternary-weight models trained from scratch (not post-training compression) achieve lossless inference at a fraction of float compute cost — viable local inference tier for cheap sub-agent tasks once model quality matures.
action_items: Monitor BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T quality benchmarks on code/reasoning tasks — threshold for Tier 1 Scribe micro-report use case
Consider as Phase 3+ local provider tier in antigravity proxy (zero-cost, zero-latency for sub-agent structured extraction)
Relevant talking point for gov client on-prem deployments: MIT, no API dependency, consumer hardware
